name: Darker
source:
Darker is a story-driven adult visual novel that delves into the intricate world of human emotions, desires, and the pursuit of revenge. Set in a world where a seemingly harmless taunt can awaken deep-seated memories, Darker explores the fragile balance between control and chaos.

[From [url=https://directorunknown.itch.io/darker]Itch.io[/url]]
